blocks.text: LAPU-LAPU CITY, Cebu — The 57 families affected by the Sitio Isla Verde, Barangay San Isidro, Talisay City fire have already received their cash assistance from the city government on Thursday, September 17. Talisay City Mayor Gerald Anthony “Samsam” Gullas said that homeowners with totally burned houses received P15,000 each, while those with partially burned houses received P10,000 each. READ: Talisay fire leaves 42 families homeless, man hurt The fire, which occurred last September 12, destroyed 46 houses — it razed 38 houses and damaged 8 more.
